The issue was that when using Pydantic models for headers, underscore-named headers were being accepted even when `convert_underscores=True` (the default). This happened because while FastAPI correctly attempted to extract values using the hyphenated alias, the original underscore-named header remained in the `received_params`. This prevents the extra parameters loop from picking up the underscore version of a header that has already been processed with `convert_underscores=True`.
